targetText: Hence, if in any process there are a number of contradictions, one of them must be the principal contradiction playing the leading and decisive role, while the rest occupy a secondary and subordinate position.
explanation: When facing multiple problems at once, one main problem controls all the others. Real-life example: If a roof is leaking during a storm, fixing squeaky floorboards can wait; fixing the leak is the main problem that must be solved first.

targetText: The principal aspect is the one playing the leading role in the contradiction. The nature of a thing is determined mainly by the principal aspect of a contradiction, the aspect which has gained the dominant position.
explanation: Inside any conflict between two sides, whichever side holds power right now defines what the situation currently looks like. Real-life example: In a sports game, if one team controls the ball 80% of the time, their playing style dictates the whole match.

targetText: We often speak of "the new superseding the old". The supersession of the old by the new is a general, eternal and inviolable law of the universe.
explanation: Over time, growing new forces build strength and eventually replace old dominant ones. Real-life example: Online video streaming started out small and weak compared to DVD rental shops, but streaming eventually grew to replace rental stores entirely.
